sprint10_priorities.description: Wave B package assembled: doc-converter, xls-converter, html. 3 examples validated and PR_DRY_RUN_READY. Blocked only by APPROVE_LIVE_PR env var.

LLM used output.pdf instead of output.jpg for Jpeg type. PdfToImage internally tries to create directory at output path — conflicts with existing file. Fix: add explicit REQUIRED constraint: 'REQUIRED: AddOutput(new FileDataSource("output.jpg")) — extension must be .jpg not .pdf'.
sprint10_priorities.constraint_to_add: REQUIRED: AddOutput(new FileDataSource("output.jpg")) — output file extension MUST be .jpg (not .pdf, not .jpeg)

sprint10_priorities.description: LLM used output.tif instead of output.tiff. File.Exists check failed because plugin uses .tiff extension. Fix: add explicit REQUIRED constraint specifying 'output.tiff' (four letters).
sprint10_priorities.constraint_to_add: REQUIRED: AddOutput(new FileDataSource("output.tiff")) — output file extension MUST be .tiff (four letters, not .tif)
